title: デビュー戦の後に・望むはティアラ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet approaches the stands completely out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph… What are you getting so worked up for? This is nothing for me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm the future number one, after all! What would I do if I tripped up during my first race?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Let's get ready for the next one. We don't have time to dawdle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet looks up at the digital track display.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The entrants for the day's next debut race are already listed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Those are names Daiwa Scarlet will be seeing in future races—and only a small handful of the racers she'll have to best on the way to the top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Which means, our next step is obvious…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm going to enter the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now comes the time to decide her tour—a crucial choice that determines an Umamusume's future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown tour with the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho… or the Tiara tour with the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho. Umamusume only get one shot at either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Choosing which path to take is tantamount to choosing one's destiny.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The most radiant Umamusume to date have all come from the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that sound right up my alley? Both for distance and elegance!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hehe, then it's settled! My next race will be the Tulip Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Tulip Sho is a renowned race known as the gateway to success in the Oka Sho. A win there will guarantee fair winds ahead.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win. No matter who I'm up against.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If I'm going to be number one, I don't have time to lose.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: The Tulip Sho is as good as ours!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah! First place is mine for the taking! I won't let anyone else have it!
